note: Submodule of registration. Adds five per-registration-type third-party booleans under key registration_admin_overrides (status, maximum_spaces, capacity, open, close) plus five matching restricted permissions. An override applies only when the type enables the boolean AND the account has the permission. Cases are grounded in that third-party config on a registration_type.

evals.prompt: The Registration Administrative Overrides submodule lets privileged users bypass registration limits. Which specific limits can be overridden, and what two things must both be true for an override to take effect for a given user?
evals.expected_output: It can override status (disabled host), maximum_spaces, capacity, open date and close date. An override applies only when the registration type enables that override (third-party setting) AND the account has the matching 'registration override ...' permission (or administer registration).

evals.prompt: In Registration Administrative Overrides, where exactly is the per-event-type override configuration stored? Give the config location and key.
evals.expected_output: As third-party settings on the registration_type config entity: registration.type.<id> -> third_party_settings.registration_admin_overrides.{status,maximum_spaces,capacity,open,close} (each a boolean). There is no separate settings form.

evals.prompt: Which permission does a user need to be allowed to add a registration AFTER an event's close date when using Registration Administrative Overrides?
evals.expected_output: The 'registration override close' permission (and the registration type must enable the 'close' override). 'administer registration' also implies it.

evals.prompt: This site has a registration type reg_ovr with exactly one administrative override enabled. Inspect its configuration and state which override (which limit an admin may bypass) is turned on.
evals.expected_output: capacity: registration.type.reg_ovr has third_party_settings.registration_admin_overrides.capacity = true (all others false).

evals.prompt: On this site, the registration type reg_ovr currently has all administrative overrides disabled. Using Registration Administrative Overrides, enable the override that lets a permitted user register after the close date, and apply the change to the live site.
